flow_ref: User story (not in any OCMS flow deck)
code_summary: ocmsadminprivateapi (cronservice): workflows/datahiveuenfin/services/DataHiveUenFinService and services/datahive/nricFinUenDataRetrieval (receiving board data); workflows/furnish_processing/helpers/FurnishApprovalHelper (the only place that resets the stage to RD1, from a hirer furnish); agencies/toppan/upload/{helpers/ToppanUploadHelper,jobs/ToppanUploadJob} and crud/ocmsizdb/OcmsValidOffenceNotice/OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository (generic RD1 letter); application-prod.properties. Other repos: no NOPO revert code for a Director/Partner
note: The story asks that once the individual Director/Partner particulars are received, OCMS reverts the NOPO to the 1st reminder (RD1) with the Director/Partner as hirer. No code does this from DataHive data: neither offender nor stage changes after the UEN sync (see OCMS11.38). The only similar mechanism is FurnishApprovalHelper.changeProcessingStage, which resets the stage to RD1 and stores a new hirer when a hirer furnish is approved; that is a furnish flow from eService/staff, not a Director/Partner from ACRA, so it is not counted. Generic RD1 letter generation to Toppan exists, but the SFTP upload to Toppan is blocked in application-prod.properties:86 (OCMS-DF-2026-192, Ready to UAT). Fits are kept equal to sibling OCMS11.19. Sheet status: Demo paid (50% of 75%); demo_remark mentions Vault Code Split. No relevant ticket besides OCMS-DF-2026-192.
recommendation: Do not claim as done. No code reverts the NOPO to RD1 for a Director/Partner from ACRA data; only the generic RD1 letter exists. Ask URA to confirm where this feature was built or mark it as a gap.

steps.step: The individual Director/Partner particulars are received from the data source (ID, position, appointment and withdrawn dates)
steps.detail: The board response is parsed into BoardInfo with personIdNo, positionHeldCode, positionAppointmentDate, positionWithdrawnDate and referencePeriod (DataHiveUENBatchService.java:483-502, UENDataResult.java:88-101). There is no person name or address, and no Director/Partner is selected by appointment period. The job is off in prod (cron-schedules-prod.properties:52). Same fit as OCMS11.38 langkah 2 dan OCMS11.40 langkah 1 (sibling).

steps.step: The NOPO is reverted to the 1st reminder (RD1) with the Director/Partner as hirer
steps.detail: After the UEN sync there is no change to next_processing_stage or the offender (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1479-1485; only noticeNo is written to ocms_nro_temp). The only reset to RD1 is in FurnishApprovalHelper.java:644-651, and it is triggered by a hirer furnish approval (OFFENDER_ROLE_HIRER = 'H'), not by Director/Partner data from ACRA. That flow is a similar mechanism but is not connected to DataHive. Same as OCMS11.19 step 2.

steps.step: The Director/Partner is recorded as the hirer together with the mailing address
steps.detail: Nothing writes the Director/Partner as offender/hirer in ocms_offence_notice_owner_driver or writes the mailing address from the UEN flow: board data is not written to the DB (DataHiveUenFinService.java:1470-1477) and only shareholders are stored (:1440-1447). Inserting an ONOD_ADDR for a new person exists only in the furnish flow (FurnishApprovalHelper.java:622-637, triggered by a furnish approval from eService/staff, not by ACRA data). Same as OCMS11.19 step 3.

steps.step: The 1st reminder (RD1) is produced and sent to the Director/Partner
steps.detail: The generic RD1 letter generation exists: findToppanNoticesForStage selects notices with next_processing_stage = 'RD1' for offender_indicator 'Y' (OcmsValidOffenceNoticeRepository.java:584-611; ToppanUploadHelper.java:1887), so the letter is addressed to the recorded offender; because the Director/Partner is never recorded as offender (previous step), they would not receive the letter. Also sftp.upload.disabledServers=toppan in application-prod.properties:86 and the delivery gate is bypassed (ToppanUploadJob.java:420-430, OCMS-DF-2026-192, status Ready to UAT), so the letter does not reach Toppan in the repo configuration.
